title: Death of Bill Steinman

tellings.quote: He died in January a couple years ago. Massive heart attack. Sheila was in the kitchen.

plain: Scott Ramsay, a man who investigates a claimed crash of a craft carrying alien bodies, says on Jesse Michels' podcast that Bill Steinman, a researcher of that same story, died near Goodyear, Arizona, in January a couple of years earlier. According to Ramsay, it was a massive heart attack, and Sheila Steinman was in the kitchen when it happened.
